lead: Kishore Kumar was an Indian singer, born on 4 August 1929 in Khandwa.
He died on 13 October 1987 in Mumbai at the age of 58.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer.
The sections that follow break down Kishore Kumar's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Kishore Kumar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kishore Kumar was born on 4 August 1929 in Khandwa, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India. He was given the name আভাষ কুমার গঙ্গোপাধ্যায় at birth and is publicly known as Kishore Kumar.
Public records name his father, Kunjalal Ganguly and his mother, Gouri Devi. He is a sibling of Ashok Kumar, Anoop Kumar and Sati Devi Mukherjee.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Kishore Kumar — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists singer, composer, film director, musician, film producer and yodeler as his occupations.

sections.heading: Kishore Kumar — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He has been married to Ruma Guha Thakurta (married 1950, until 1958), Yogeeta Bali (married 1975, until 1978) and Leena Chandavarkar (married 1980, until 1987).
He is a parent to Amit Kumar and Sumit Kumar.

paras: Net-worth figures for Kishore Kumar circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a singer, composer, film director, musician, film producer and yodeler.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
